thesis: Macro is mixed but restrictive for a high-duration growth multiple. The Fed raised the target range to 3.75%-4.00% on Sep. 16 and the 10-year real Treasury yield was 2.61% on Sep. 17, increasing discount-rate pressure. Offsetting this, NFCI remains looser than average and IG/HY spreads are tight, so there is no systemic funding stress. APP's large FCF and modest net debt reduce financing sensitivity versus small-cap growth. Recommend 0.85x pacing rather than a thesis downgrade.

evidence.claim: The FOMC raised the federal-funds target range to 3.75%-4.00% on Sep. 16.
The 10-year real Treasury yield was 2.61% on Sep. 17.
evidence.source: U.S. Treasury daily real yield curve

evidence.claim: Chicago Fed NFCI was -0.560 for the week ending Sep. 11, indicating looser-than-average financial conditions.
IG OAS was 0.78% and HY OAS 2.70% on Sep. 16, indicating contained credit stress.
APP had H1 FCF of $2.150B and only modest net debt, reducing dependence on external capital.

counterevidence: Tight credit spreads and negative NFCI indicate no broad liquidity shock.
APP is internally financed and therefore less sensitive to capital-market closure.
Strong private demand can support ad budgets even with restrictive rates.
Lower bond yields after the FOMC meeting could ease duration pressure if sustained.
unknowns: Whether the September hike is followed by more tightening.
Ad-budget sensitivity to slower nominal growth.
Whether risk appetite for high-multiple software/adtech deteriorates.
falsifiers: Real yields fall materially while credit remains easy, supporting a higher multiplier.
NFCI turns positive and spreads widen sharply, requiring lower pacing.
APP FCF/share weakens enough that macro funding conditions become operationally relevant.

key_kpis.name: 10-year real yield
key_kpis.threshold: Below ~2.25% supports faster pacing; sustained >2.75% warrants caution

key_kpis.name: NFCI / credit spreads
key_kpis.threshold: Negative NFCI and contained spreads support risk budget

key_kpis.name: Ad-demand macro sensitivity
key_kpis.threshold: No sharp slowdown in advertiser spend
